BREAKING NEWS 🚨 Five years after COVID-19, a new virus has emerged: the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV).

HMPV is spreading rapidly in China and across several Asian countries, with reports of a sharp rise in respiratory illnesses.

#HMPV #Vir
